matches.title: Cagliari vs Udinese
matches.description: Watch Cagliari vs Udinese highlights and goals from Serie A on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 9, 2026. Cagliari and Udinese faced off in a crucial Serie A fixture on May 9, 2026, with both sides desperate to secure a defining result in the latter stages of the season. The atmosphere at the stadium was electric as the hosts looked to leverage their home advantage against a resilient visiting side. Early Pressure and VAR Intervention Cagliari dominated the opening exchanges, maintaining a staggering 62% of possession throughout the contest. Early attempts from outside the box by Juan Rodriguez and Michael Folorunsho signaled their intent, though neither could find the target. The match took a dramatic turn in the 33rd minute when the referee paused play for a lengthy VAR check regarding a potential penalty for the home side. Much to the frustration of the home crowd, the initial call stood, and no penalty was awarded, leaving the match scoreless as both teams headed into the tunnels at halftime. Clinical Counter and Defensive Heroics Shortly after the restart, Cagliari nearly took the lead when Sebastiano Esposito saw his goal-bound effort heroically hacked off the line by the Udinese defense. However, the momentum shifted in the 56th minute when the visitors struck against the run of play. A brilliant key pass from Oumar Solet released Hassane Kamara , who provided a pinpoint assist for Adam Buksa to tap home from close range. The goal forced Cagliari into a tactical reshuffle, bringing on veteran Andrea Belotti to bolster their attacking options. Stoppage Time Drama Seals the Win The closing stages were characterized by desperate Cagliari pressure and spectacular defending from Udinese . Alberto Dossena had a shot cleared off the line in the 76th minute, and Paul Mendy even attempted an audacious bicycle kick that flew wide. Despite the relentless onslaught, Udinese remained organized and struck a final blow in the 6th minute of stoppage time. Keinan Davis turned provider, setting up substitute Idrissa Gueye for a simple finish to double the lead. Led by a Man of the Match performance from Oumar Solet , the visitors navigated the final moments to secure a hard-fought away victory.

A high-stakes Serie A encounter on May 3, 2026 , saw two of Italy’s most competitive sides trade blows in a match defined by momentum shifts and clinical finishing. Both clubs searched for supremacy in a contest that kept the supporters on the edge of their seats until the very last second. Bologna’s Early Command Bologna began the afternoon with aggressive intent, needing only nine minutes to break the deadlock. Juan Miranda turned provider with a pinpoint pass to Federico Bernardeschi , who composed himself to fire a left-footed shot into the back of the net. The momentum was firmly with the hosts, and they nearly doubled their lead shortly after when Juan Miranda rattled the post with a fierce strike that had the SSC Napoli defense scrambling. The pressure eventually led to a decisive VAR intervention in the 32nd minute. After reviewing a challenge by Giovanni Di Lorenzo on Juan Miranda , the referee awarded a penalty. Riccardo Orsolini stepped up in the 34th minute and, despite Vanja Milinkovic-Savic getting a hand to it, the power of the strike ensured the ball found the net to make it 2-0. Napoli Strike Back Just as Bologna seemed to be cruising toward halftime, SSC Napoli found a lifeline. In the second minute of first-half stoppage time, Giovanni Di Lorenzo reacted quickest to a loose ball in the box, stabbing it home to reduce the deficit. The goal revitalized the visitors, who emerged for the second half with renewed vigor. Only three minutes after the restart, Napoli were level. Rasmus Højlund showcased his vision to find Alisson Santos , who clinicaly finished with his right foot to make it 2-2. The game then descended into a tense tactical battle, characterized by several yellow cards, including bookings for Jhon Lucumí and Matteo Politano , as both sides fought for every inch of grass. Rowe’s Moment of Magic As the match entered the 90th minute, the stage was set for a hero. In the first minute of added time, substitute Jonathan Rowe produced a moment of pure brilliance. Connecting with a cross in the box, Rowe launched into a spectacular bicycle kick, sending the ball past the keeper to restore Bologna's lead in breathtaking fashion. SSC Napoli threw everything forward in the final moments, with Amir Rrahmani seeing a late header saved by Massimo Pessina . Despite the late pressure and a flurry of corners, the home side held firm to secure a 3-2 victory, leaving the fans at the stadium breathless after a true football spectacle.

matches.title: AC Milan vs Cagliari
matches.description: Watch AC Milan vs Cagliari highlights and goals from Serie A on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 24, 2026. The lights of the legendary San Siro stadium shone brightly on 2026-05-24 for a clash that promised tactical intrigue and high-stakes drama. Fans gathered to witness a fixture where every transition mattered and momentum shifted with every whistle. Early Fireworks at the San Siro The match exploded into life almost immediately. In just the second minute, AC Milan took the lead through Alexis Saelemaekers , who finished clinically with his right foot. The move was orchestrated by a key pass from Fikayo Tomori , which found Santiago Gimenez , who provided the decisive assist. In the chaos of the early goal, Cagliari 's Ze Pedro was cautioned with a yellow card as the visitors struggled to find their footing. A Resilient Response Despite the early setback, the visitors began to find their rhythm. In the 20th minute, Cagliari found their equalizer. After a corner from Adam Obert led to a blocked effort by Yerry Mina , the ball fell to Gennaro Borrelli , who made no mistake with a left-footed strike to level the score. AC Milan attempted to regain control, with Youssouf Fofana seeing a header comfortably saved by Elia Caprile just after the half-hour mark, but the teams went into the interval on level terms. Momentum Shifts and Second Half Drama The second half saw AC Milan introduce Christian Pulisic to add more attacking threat. However, it was Cagliari who seized the initiative. In the 57th minute, Juan Rodriguez pounced on a loose ball to head home, putting the visitors in front. The goal sparked frustration in the Milan ranks, with Strahinja Pavlovic receiving a booking and goalkeeper Mike Maignan also seeing yellow for dissent as the home side protested the unfolding events. Desperate Final Efforts In a bid to rescue a point, AC Milan made a flurry of substitutions, bringing on Luka Modric , Rafael Leao , and Niclas Fuellkrug . Despite intense pressure and several corner kicks delivered by Modric , the equalizer remained elusive. Cagliari 's defense, led by Alberto Dossena , remained resolute, intercepting crucial crosses deep into stoppage time. Even as Ibrahim Sulemana received a late yellow card for a tactical foul, the visitors held their nerve until the final whistle to secure a memorable victory.

As the game entered its closing stages, tempers flared, resulting in yellow cards for Guillermo Maripan and Paul Mendy due to a scuffle in the 82nd minute.
